note: Likely false as stated in standard co-clone semantics. Every relational clone contains all diagonal relations; =3 is pp-definable as x=y ∧ y=z; and for |A| >= 3 the binary relations (all unary relations plus ≠) already pp-generate Rel(A). note: The outcome depends on the setting. In the co-clone sense on a finite A it is plausible: on {0,1}, a single ternary relation such as 1-in-3 generates everything. In PAL/bond settings, Koshkin reports that reduction to triads fails on finite domains (see rows 125/126).
